description: Create, update, delete, or link work items (issues, epics, tasks). Actions: create (epics need GROUP namespace, issues/tasks need PROJECT), update (widgets: dates, time tracking, weight, iterations, health, progress, hierarchy), delete (permanent), delete_timelog (remove a time tracking entry by its global ID), add_link/remove_link (BLOCKS/BLOCKED_BY/RELATED). Related: browse_work_items for discovery.

action.description: Action to perform: create, update, delete, delete_timelog, add_link, remove_link

addLabelIds.description: Array of label IDs to ADD to existing labels. Can be used with removeLabelIds. Cannot be used with labelIds. Required for 'update' action(s).

assigneeIds.description: Array of assignee user IDs Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

childrenIds.description: Array of child work item IDs to add Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

color.description: Custom hex color for epics (Ultimate tier) Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

description.description: Description of the work item Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

dueDate.description: Due date in YYYY-MM-DD format (null to clear) Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

healthStatus.description: Health status indicator, null to clear (Ultimate tier) Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

id.description: Work item ID - use numeric ID from list results (e.g., '5953') Required for 'update', 'delete', 'add_link', 'remove_link' action(s).

isFixed.description: Fixed dates - not inherited from children (Premium tier) Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

iterationId.description: Iteration/sprint ID, null to unassign (Premium tier) Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

labelIds.description: Array of label IDs to SET (replaces all existing labels). Cannot be used with addLabelIds or removeLabelIds. Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

linkType.description: Relationship type to create. Use with targetId to link work items during update. Applied via separate mutation after the main update. Required for 'update', 'add_link' action(s).

namespace.description: CRITICAL: Namespace path (group OR project). For Epics use GROUP path (e.g. "my-group"). For Issues/Tasks use PROJECT path (e.g. "my-group/my-project"). Required for 'create' action(s).

parentId.description: Parent work item ID to set hierarchy relationship Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

progressCurrentValue.description: Current progress value 0-100 for OKR key results (Premium tier) Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

removeLabelIds.description: Array of label IDs to REMOVE from existing labels. Can be used with addLabelIds. Cannot be used with labelIds. Required for 'update' action(s).

startDate.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (null to clear) Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

state.description: State event for the work item (CLOSE, REOPEN) Required for 'update' action(s).

targetId.description: Target work item ID to link to. Use with linkType to create a relationship during update. Required for 'update', 'add_link', 'remove_link' action(s).

timeEstimate.description: Time estimate (e.g. "1h 30m", "2d"). Applied via update after create. Check _warning in response if application failed. Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

timeSpent.description: Time spent to log as timelog entry (e.g. "2h", "1h 30m") Required for 'update' action(s).

timeSpentAt.description: When time was spent in ISO 8601 format (defaults to now) Required for 'update' action(s).

timeSpentSummary.description: Summary/description of work done for the timelog entry Required for 'update' action(s).

timelogId.description: Global ID of the timelog entry (gid://gitlab/Timelog/N) — obtain from work item's TIME_TRACKING widget via browse_work_items get action Required for 'delete_timelog' action(s).

title.description: Title of the work item Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

verificationStatus.description: Set verification status for requirement work items: PASSED or FAILED (Ultimate tier). Creates a test report internally. Required for 'update' action(s).

weight.description: Story points / weight value, null to clear (Premium tier) Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

workItemType.description: Type of work item Required for 'create' action(s).

name: manage_work_item
